SRTN.description: Smart Report Tree Node (SRTN). One node of the Smart Report menu tree: each row is either a Folder (container) or a Data (leaf) item, linked into a tree via PARENT and categorized by DATA_TYPE.

REF_DATA.description: Reference data key for leaf items (the actual body key that a Data node points to).

ORDER.description: Display order within the same parent (0-based).

DATA_TYPE.description: Smart Report category / data type (case-insensitive). UFIG_LST=User Defined Images, UIMG_LST=Image Files (PNG/JPG attachments), UTBL_LST=User Defined Tables, USSS_LST=Section Summary, USRS_LST=Reinforcement of Sections, USCS_LST=Composite Section for Construction Stage, UTPL_LST=Table Templates, UCHT_LST=Charts, USUM_LST=User Defined Texts.

ITEM_TYPE.description: Item type (case-insensitive): Folder is a container, Data is a leaf that references REF_DATA.

NAME.description: Display name of the tree node.
